It is possible to leave the Antica Via del Cifalco from the municipalities or other inhabited places located along the walk or reachable with a detour. Note, however, that public transport in these areas is scarce – or non-existent.

Leaving aside uninhabited hamlets and the places already recommended as end points of the itinerary, leaving the Way on a tarmac road with access to some form of public transport is theoretically possible from: Cerignale, Casanova, Fontanigorda, Barbagelata, Neirone, Gattorna, Uscio and Ruta.

In an emergency, motor vehicles can come to give assistance at any other point where the Strada del Cifalco crosses a road passable by vehicles, namely: Oneto, Bivio Veri, the summit of M. Dego (only with a 4x4, if the driver cares about his underbody), the Valico del Fregarolo, Barbagelata, the Passo della Scoglina, Neirone, Cassanesi, the Colonia Arnaldi (near Uscio) and the Passo della Spinarola.

Please note that Fausto Caprile (Albergo Caprile, near Uscio) offers his guests the option of picking them up from and taking them back to any place on the Via del Cifalco that can be reached by motor vehicle. For more information and rates, contact him on +39 333 62 63 423.
